title: CustomerPutRequest
description: A registered customer put request. Required fields are firstName, surname, password, organizationId, changedBy and changedByChannel.

changedBy.description: Who last changed the customer. Either web, app or username of employee. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

changedByChannel.description: Which sales channel or system who last changed the customer. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

countryCode.description: Telephone number country code, starting with +.

customerAccountId.description: Deprecated. The field is no longer stored. Use /profiles/{customerNumber}/customer-accounts. Customer account id used for account based ticketing.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. ISO 8601 date format

email.description: Email used for contact and potentially also for login

emailVerifiedAt.description: When the email was verified. ISO 8601 date format

expirationDate.description: The date when the customers personal data should be deleted. Personal data will be deleted continuously. ISO 8601 date format

languagePreference.description: Deprecated, please use languagePreferenceISO6393. Which language the customer wants information in. Default is 'NO'.

languagePreferenceISO6393.description: Which language the customer wants information in. ISO 639-3 format. Default is 'NOB'.

nationality.description: The customers nationality. ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format

postalAddresses.description: The postal addresses connected to the customer.

status.description: Customer status. Statuses supported: 'A' = Active, 'P' = Passive, 'D' = Deleted. Default is 'A'.

telephoneNumber.description: Deprecated. Please use countryCode and telephoneNumberNoCountryCode. Telephone number for customer. This should be a cell phone number.

telephoneNumberNoCountryCode.description: Telephone number without country code or punctuation.

telephoneNumberVerifiedAt.description: When the telephone number was verified. ISO 8601 date format

vippsId.description: Deprecated. The field is no longer stored and is ignored. Vipps unique user identifier.

addressLine2.description: Address line 2, often used for c/o information.

countryCode.description: The address country code. ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format

id.description: Unique id for postal address. This value is exclusively used when updating a full customer, to identify which of the addresses to update. Otherwise it is ignored.

postCode.description: The address post code. Only 4 digits for Norwegian addresses.

town.description: The address post town. Will be required

typeOfAddress.description: The type of address. Types supported: 'P' = Private, 'I' = Invoice, 'S' = Shadow.

verifiedAt.description: When the address was verified. ISO 8601 date format

PostalAddressRequest.description: Postal address connected to a customer
